info.title: RailNow API — South Korea Real-Time Subway & Railway Data
info.description:
**🔑 [Get your free API key (Developer Center) →](https://railnow.runvia.app/developer?lang=en)** · [Korean docs](https://railnow.runvia.app/api/docs)

RailNow provides developer-friendly access to South Korea's subway and railway data, including real-time train locations, station information, route distances, travel times, and operational statistics.

Designed to make Korean railway data accessible to developers worldwide, without requiring Korean phone number verification.

#### Authentication
- Every request needs an API key in the `X-API-Key` header. Sign in with Google at the [developer center](https://railnow.runvia.app/developer?lang=en) to get a free key (`jl_...`), then click **Authorize** to try requests here.
- Each key can make up to 500 requests per hour and 5,000 requests per day. Both windows start from the time the key was issued and reset every hour and every 24 hours from that time; requests over a limit return 429 with a `Retry-After` header.
- Also available on RapidAPI.

#### Attribution
- **Every service that uses RailNow data must credit us as the data provider by showing our logo on screens that display the data.**
- We recommend the "Provided by" logo. Pick the one that fits your background and, where possible, link it to https://railnow.runvia.app. Do not stretch, recolor or alter the logos.

![Provided by RailNow](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-provided-by-universal.svg)

| Background | "Provided by" logo | RailNow logo |
|---|---|---|
| Light | [SVG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-provided-by-light.svg) · [PNG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-provided-by-light.png) | [SVG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-logo-light.svg) · [PNG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-logo-light.png) |
| Dark | [SVG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-provided-by-dark.svg) · [PNG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-provided-by-dark.png) | [SVG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-logo-dark.svg) · [PNG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-logo-dark.png) |
| Any | [SVG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-provided-by-universal.svg) · [PNG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-provided-by-universal.png) | [SVG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-logo-universal.svg) · [PNG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-logo-universal.png) |

Square icon: [SVG](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-icon.svg) · [PNG 512×512](https://railnow.runvia.app/brand/railnow-icon.png). Previews and HTML snippets are in the [developer center](https://railnow.runvia.app/developer?lang=en).

#### Response language
Add `lang=en` to any request to get station names, line names, train statuses, directions, messages, and other data values in English (e.g. `Arrived` instead of `도착`, `Up` instead of `상행`). Without it (or with `lang=ko`), values are returned in Korean as provided by the source data.

get.summary: List subway lines
get.description: Retrieves the full list of operating subway lines including line IDs and line names.

get.summary: Search stations

Searches subway stations by name or Korean initial consonants (Chosung, e.g. "ㄱㄴ" -> "Gangnam").

get.summary: Get the real-time arrival board for a station
get.description:
Returns calibrated real-time train positions and arrival seconds by direction within 5 stations.
If no train is within range, up to 3 upcoming trains are returned (mode: FAR).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Response language. Pre-filled with `en` here so station names, line names, train statuses, directions, messages and errors come back in English. If you omit it, the server responds in Korean (`ko`).

nowTime.description: Time the response was generated (KST, human-readable format)

mode.description: `NEARBY`: trains were found within the 5 stations preceding the current station. `FAR`: no train is within that range, so up to 3 trains that will reach the current station from farther away are returned instead.

stopsAway.description: Number of physical stops from the current station (1 means the immediately preceding station)

previousStations.description: Up to 5 stations a train passes through before reaching the current station in this direction, ordered from farthest to nearest

directions.description: Preceding stations for each direction (up, down, etc.) that serves this station

stopsAway.description: Number of physical stops remaining until the current station (0 means the train is at the current station)

terminatesAtCurrentStation.description: Whether the current station is this train's terminal station

terminatesBeforeCurrentStation.description: Whether the train terminates before reaching the current station (if so, `arrivalEtaSeconds` is null)

arrivalEtaSeconds.description: Estimated seconds until arrival at the current station. Null for trains that do not reach the current station

trainStatus.description: Meaning of the `status` values: `접근` (approaching): about to arrive at a station / `도착` (arrived): stopped at a station / `출발` (departed): has just left a station / `운행중` (running): moving between stations / `운행종료` (ended): considered out of service once the grace period after arriving at the terminal station has passed (train API only) / `운행예정` (scheduled): has not yet departed its origin station (train API only). The fields included differ by status, so fields without a value may be omitted or null. When `mode` is `RAW` (lines without a timetable), `접근`/`도착`/`출발`/`운행중` are roughly inferred from the real-time API's `arvlCd` alone; only `currentStation`, `currentStaId`, `remainingSeconds`, and `textKorean` are populated, and timetable-based fields (`scheduled*`, `progress`, `nextAction`, etc.) are not included.

previousStation.description: Name of the station the train last departed (`운행중` status)

scheduledArriveTime.description: Scheduled arrival time from the timetable

scheduledDepartureTime.description: Scheduled departure time from the timetable

scheduledPreviousDeparture.description: Scheduled departure time from the previous station (`운행중` status)

scheduledNextArrive.description: Scheduled arrival time at the next station (`운행중` status)

previousDeparture.description: Actual (estimated) departure time from the previous station, including delay

nextArrive.description: Actual (estimated) arrival time at the next station, including delay

remainingSeconds.description: `운행예정` status: seconds until departure. `RAW` mode: seconds until arrival at the current station as reported by the real-time API (`barvlDt`)

delaySeconds.description: Delay in seconds (actual minus scheduled; negative means ahead of schedule). Null in `운행예정` status because it is not yet known

progress.description: Included only in detail requests. Progress through the current phase (e.g. from `접근` to `운행중`)

total.description: Total length of the phase in seconds

nextAction.description: Included only in detail requests. The upcoming status transition (null if there are no further transitions)

status.description: The `status` value the train will change to next

trainInfo.description: Train information. Destination prefers a confirmed stable API announcement, otherwise the timetable; a destination announcement does not prove where the train actually terminated. Train type comes from realtime data; direction and express may come from the timetable.

destinationPending.description: An API destination exists but is not confirmed for display; keep the timetable or previous confirmed value

destinationChange.description: Confirmed destination announcement change; not proof of actual termination

direction.description: Direction: `상행` (up) | `하행` (down) | `내선` (inner circle) | `외선` (outer circle). Null if not in the timetable

express.description: Whether the train is an express (null if not in the timetable)

trainType.description: Train type: `일반` (local) | `급행` (express) | `ITX`. Included only when confirmed by real-time data; when unknown, the field is omitted rather than guessed.

specialService.description: DEPOT_RUN: depot service; UNVERIFIED_RUN: 9xxx number observed, temporary or diverted operation unconfirmed; UNSCHEDULED_RERUN: rerun without a matching timetable.

realtimeData.description: Matched raw data received from the Seoul real-time subway API (values before calibration). Null when no real-time data is matched (ended, estimated, or scheduled status).

trainNo.description: Train number, normalized (e.g. leading zeros removed)

destinationName.description: Destination name announced by the source API

stationId.description: ID of the station where this data was observed

status.description: Seoul API arrival code (`arvlCd`). 2 = departed the previous station; 0, 1, 3, 4, 5 = imminent events such as entering or arriving; 99 = not yet tracked (placeholder while running)

sourceReceivedAt.description: Time the Seoul API updated this data (KST, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS")

arrivalMsg2.description: Secondary arrival message (usually the station name)

isLast.description: Whether this is the last train of the day

trains.description: All nearby trains, or up to 3 distant trains, depending on `mode`

message.description: Error message describing the cause (in Korean)
Error message describing the cause (in Korean)

get.summary: Get real-time train positions by line
get.description:
Retrieves calibrated real-time positions and statuses for all active trains on the specified line.
Supports direction filtering (`direction`: UP/DOWN) and train type filtering (`trainType`: EXPRESS/LOCAL).
Lines without timetables are returned with mode: "RAW".

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Response language. Pre-filled with `en` here so station names, line names, train statuses, directions, messages and errors come back in English. If you omit it, the server responds in Korean (`ko`).

nowTime.description: Time the response was generated (KST, human-readable format)

trains.description: Calibrated current position of each train detected in real time

mode.description: `LIVE`: status calibrated against the timetable / `RAW`: the line has no timetable (e.g. privately operated lines), so only raw real-time data is provided

trainStatus.description: Meaning of the `status` values: `접근` (approaching): about to arrive at a station / `도착` (arrived): stopped at a station / `출발` (departed): has just left a station / `운행중` (running): moving between stations / `운행종료` (ended): considered out of service once the grace period after arriving at the terminal station has passed (train API only) / `운행예정` (scheduled): has not yet departed its origin station (train API only). get.summary: Get the status and history of a single train
get.description:
Retrieves real-time calibrated status, delay seconds, and operational mode for a specific train.
Provides second-level calibration while running, terminal delay when ended, and scheduled departure before origin departure.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Response language. Pre-filled with `en` here so station names, line names, train statuses, directions, messages and errors come back in English. If you omit it, the server responds in Korean (`ko`).

trainNo.description: Train number. As written in the timetable (e.g. X0059) when matched to a timetable (`mode` is not `RAW`); otherwise (`RAW`), as written in the raw real-time data

mode.description: `LIVE`: current status calibrated with real-time data / `ENDED`: considered out of service because real-time data stopped updating for the grace period after arrival at the terminal station / `ESTIMATED`: the train should be running per the timetable but there is no real-time data, so its position is estimated from the timetable alone / `SCHEDULED`: has not yet departed its origin station / `RAW`: the line has no timetable (privately operated lines such as the Ui-Sinseol Line, GTX-A, Shinbundang Line, and Sillim Line), so only the raw real-time position is provided, without delay calibration

dataSource.description: COLLECTED | TIMETABLE | LAST_OBSERVED (historical observation, not a confirmed termination)

sourceTimeQuality.description: valid | missing | invalid | future_corrected; null for legacy observations

lastObservedAt.description: Last observation timestamp in KST, for RAW historical records

destinationHistory.description: Confirmed stable destination announcements for a RAW run; not actual termination records

trainStatus.description: Meaning of the `status` values: `접근` (approaching): about to arrive at a station / `도착` (arrived): stopped at a station / `출발` (departed): has just left a station / `운행중` (running): moving between stations / `운행종료` (ended): considered out of service once the grace period after arriving at the terminal station has passed (train API only) / `운행예정` (scheduled): has not yet departed its origin station (train API only). The fields included differ by status, so fields without a value may be omitted or null. When `mode` is `RAW` (lines without a timetable), `접근`/`도착`/`출발`/`운행중` are roughly inferred from the real-time API's `arvlCd` alone; only `currentStation`, `currentStaId`, `remainingSeconds`, and `textKorean` are populated, and timetable-based fields (`scheduled*`, `progress`, `nextAction`, etc.) are not included.

previousStation.description: Name of the station the train last departed (`운행중` status)

scheduledArriveTime.description: Scheduled arrival time from the timetable

scheduledDepartureTime.description: Scheduled departure time from the timetable

scheduledPreviousDeparture.description: Scheduled departure time from the previous station (`운행중` status)

scheduledNextArrive.description: Scheduled arrival time at the next station (`운행중` status)

previousDeparture.description: Actual (estimated) departure time from the previous station, including delay

nextArrive.description: Actual (estimated) arrival time at the next station, including delay

remainingSeconds.description: `운행예정` status: seconds until departure. `RAW` mode: seconds until arrival at the current station as reported by the real-time API (`barvlDt`)

delaySeconds.description: Delay in seconds (actual minus scheduled; negative means ahead of schedule). Null in `운행예정` status because it is not yet known

progress.description: Included only in detail requests. Progress through the current phase (e.g. from `접근` to `운행중`)

total.description: Total length of the phase in seconds

nextAction.description: Included only in detail requests. The upcoming status transition (null if there are no further transitions)
